nativeProfileTools.signIn: Sign in to view your bank data.
nativeProfileTools.detectionAnswer: Repeating bank payments suggest subscriptions. Review a match to confirm or dismiss it.
nativeProfileTools.trackingAnswer: No. Pause and archive only change tracking in SubTrack.
nativeProfileTools.familyQuestion: Can family profiles see bank transactions?
nativeProfileTools.familyAnswer: No. Family profiles organize your plans and their cost shares; they do not receive access to your bank transactions.
